ios.desc:
WAPPS is a browser optimized for video websites and many other of the sites you love. 

Our goal is to make browsing websites on mobile just as fun and easy as using an app. 

It’s optimized for the sites you love - Youtube, Reddit, Twitter, Twitch, TikTok and more. 

We block ads, popups asking you to use the mobile app and other things. If you want something else blocked just message us! We also let you instantly enter Picture-in-picture mode with the tap of a button from any site!

If this excites you, join our community to help us build, and get rewarded! Go to join.wapps.app or tap the Discord button in the app.

A bit more about us:

Our goal is to build a browser that makes browsing the web fun again. 

Right now we do things like:

- Never worry about managing your tabs or bookmarks again. Instead we learn what sites you frequent and make it easy for you to see what you want to see using machine learning and other tools.
- Built in Ad Blocker: Never see an ad again! An always on, default ad blocker you don’t need to configure. Works on Youtube and many other sites. If you see an ad put a link to the site in the Discord
- Forced dark mode: Convert everysite to be dark mode compatable. Great for night time browsing!
- Search helpers to help you quickly search the sites you love
- Quickly get the answer you are looking for. We launch with the keyboard up so you can lookup whatever is on your mind as fast as possible!
- Get lost in the content. Our always on full screen mode makes it so every website feels like an app. Easily swipe up at any time to search, copy the page, or more.
- Enhances PWAs (Progressive web apps), dApps (decentralised apps -> coming soon) and normal websites to be faster and more fun to browse.
- Sharing has never been easier. One tap to copy link and share the page anywhere you want.
- Private browsing, but still usable. No information is uploaded to our server. But we show you the sites you frequently access for quick access and keep you logged in.
- All free, and no ads
- Make copying or sharing the current link as easy as possible with just a tap


What features would you like?

Join our Discord community at https://join.wapps.app !

quotes.text:
A while back I had an idea of making a browser that "translated" mobile websites into a better experience for mobile.

I didn't really know where to start but then I thought that the entire "container" experience of browsing websites on mobile could be better. I had some ideas and this is a mixture of many of them:

* clear app launch with keyboard up to quickly search

* "intelligent" search suggestions so you don't have to manage bookmarks/tabs that learns your browsing history and what sites you visit (lots of ideas here)

* ad blocking

* banners and "download the app" banner blocker (on some sites)

* dark mode-ify websites

* Easily re-run your query on other sites (reddit, youtube, etc) (similar to SWURL that was posted here)

* Search helpers to quickly run your query where you want

* Quickly create new tabs and swipe between them

* Zoom gesture to enter full screen browsing mode that makes it feel like any website is an app!

* A Video player bar that shows on pages with videos to easily control things like play/pause, airplay/chromecast, PiP, change playback speed, and more)

* Customize the colors

* Purely local, no data is sent to a server (i'm too lazy to do that)

I think that's about all the ideas i've built in so far, but I have many others.

And if you have cool ideas, feedback, bugs, complaints please join the Discord and lets chat!: https://discord.gg/Njd8uzCF8P
